Header.description: Multimodal Scene Descriptors Header – Standard OSD-MSD-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Multimodal Scene is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Multimodal Scene is or is intended to be located.

MultimodalSceneDescriptorsID.description: Unique identifier of this Multimodal Scene Descriptors instance.

MultimodalSceneDescriptorsTime.description: Time this Multimodal Scene Descriptors instance was produced.

MultimodalSceneDescriptorsSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Multimodal Scene Descriptors instance is located.

UserPoV.description: Where the Scene is heard and seen from.

ClosedSpace.description: The Closed Space the Scene is in, placed by MultimodalSceneDescriptorsSpaceTime. A Basic Scene in this Scene with a Closed Space of its own keeps it for its members.

AudioObjectCount.description: Number of Audio Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

AudioObjects.description: Set of Audio Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

AudioObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Audio Object is located within the Multimodal Scene.

AudioObject.description: A Basic Audio Object or an Audio Object, or its ID.

SpeechObjectCount.description: Number of Speech Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

SpeechObjects.description: Set of Speech Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

SpeechObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Speech Object is located within the Multimodal Scene.

SpeechObject.description: A Basic Speech Object or a Speech Object, or its ID.

VisualObjectCount.description: Number of Visual Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

VisualObjects.description: Set of Visual Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

VisualObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Visual Object is located within the Multimodal Scene.

VisualObject.description: Either a Visual Object or the ID of a Visual Object.

3DModelObjectCount.description: Number of 3D Model Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

3DModelObjects.description: Set of 3D Model Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

3DModelObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this 3D Model Object is located within the Multimodal Scene.

3DModelObject.description: Either a 3D Model Object or the ID of a 3D Model Object.

AudioVisualObjectCount.description: Number of Multimodal Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

AudioVisualObjects.description: Set of Multimodal Objects in the Multimodal Scene.

AudioVisualObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Multimodal Object is located within the Multimodal Scene.

AudioVisualObject.description: Either a Multimodal Object or the ID of a Multimodal Object.

SubAudioSceneCount.description: Number of Audio Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubAudioScenes.description: Set of Audio Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubAudioSceneSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Audio Sub-Scene is located within the Multimodal Scene.

SubAudioScene.description: A Basic Audio Scene Descriptors or an Audio Scene Descriptors instance, or its ID.

SubSpeechSceneCount.description: Number of Speech Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubSpeechScenes.description: Set of Speech Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubVisualSceneCount.description: Number of Visual Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubVisualScenes.description: Set of Visual Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

Sub3DModelSceneSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this 3D Model Sub-Scene is located within the Multimodal Scene.

Sub3DModelScene.description: Either a 3D Model Scene Descriptors instance or its ID.

SubMultimodalSceneCount.description: Number of Multimodal Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubMultimodalScenes.description: Set of Multimodal Sub-Scenes in the Multimodal Scene.

SubMultimodalSceneSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Multimodal Sub-Scene is located within the Multimodal Scene.

SubMultimodalScene.description: A Basic Multimodal Scene Descriptors or a Multimodal Scene Descriptors instance, or its ID.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Multimodal Scene Descriptors instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Multimodal Scene Descriptors instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
